2.2. om_integration.pi_program¶

This module provides utilities for extracting unmatched variables from a PiProgram that has been merged with another program.

Functions

extract_unmatched_vars_from_seif_prog(prog)

Returns the name of all variables in the given program that were not matched with a with an input or equation in the PiSPEC model.
